lead.headline: TESLA HITS THE STREETS WITH CYBERCAB PUBLIC ROAD TESTS
lead.summary: The electric vehicle giant has taken its futuristic two-seat Cybercab out of the lab and onto the public roads of Austin, Texas. Engineering tests are officially underway in real-world city traffic, marking a massive leap toward a fully driverless ride-hailing service. This early step puts the company's autonomous taxi ambitions to the ultimate test on public asphalt.

stories.headline: Regulatory Quirk Grants Free Waymo Rides In California
stories.summary: A bureaucratic delay from a California state agency has handed passengers a lucky break. Robotaxi rides in Waymo's new Ojai vehicle might remain completely free of charge for a few more months. Commuters are cheering the regulatory sluggishness as they enjoy free high-tech travel.

stories.headline: Joyriding Teens Nabbed After High-Tech Robotaxi Takedown
stories.summary: A wild joyride ended in handcuffs after a group of California teenagers used a robotaxi as a rolling fortress. Police intercepted the vehicle after the youths allegedly blasted a local city with water beads and consumed alcohol inside. The autonomous cruiser eventually pulled over on its own, delivering the suspects straight to the law.

stories.headline: GM-Backed Momenta Debuts Muted In Hong Kong
stories.summary: The highly anticipated public market debut of self-driving outfit Momenta fell flat on its face in Hong Kong. Shares of the GM-backed unicorn rose a meager 2.8 percent on opening day. Wall Street watchers blame growing investor skepticism over when, if ever, autonomous vehicles will turn a profit.

stories.headline: China Cost Cuts Fuel Trillion-Dollar Robotaxi Dream
stories.summary: Slashed supply chain costs in China are putting the global autonomous taxi market on a fast track to a one-trillion-dollar valuation by 2040. Financial heavyweights at Morgan Stanley predict a fierce global race led by Waymo and Tesla, with Chinese rivals scaling rapidly. Cheap manufacturing is proving to be the ultimate fuel for the driverless revolution.

stories.headline: Fireworks And Traffic Clogs Strand Waymo Fleet
stories.summary: Independence Day celebrations turned into a mechanical nightmare for Waymo's robotaxis in San Francisco. A fleet of the driverless cabs became hopelessly gridlocked in heavy traffic, with several running out of battery power entirely. Terrified passengers watched as the autonomous vehicles drove straight toward exploding street fireworks.

lead.headline: OPENAI SECURES GOVERNMENT GREEN LIGHT FOR POWERFUL GPT-5.6 RELEASE
lead.summary: Uncle Sam has cleared the way for the next big leap in artificial intelligence. The U.S. Department of Commerce officially gave OpenAI the green light to roll out its highly anticipated and advanced GPT-5.6 model series. The green light comes after a tense delay sparked by government anxieties over potential cybersecurity risks. Tech circles expect the powerful brain to hit the public as early as this week.

stories.headline: Anthropic Discovers Human-Like 'J-Space' Reasoning Hub
stories.summary: Researchers at Anthropic have uncovered a secret chamber inside large language models. Dubbed the 'JSpace,' this emergent region of model weights acts like human conscious thought, handling complex multi-step reasoning. The breakthrough could hold the key to solving the industry's biggest alignment headaches.

stories.headline: Amazon Secretly Plots New 'Moonraker' Alexa AI Upgrade
stories.summary: Rumors are swirling out of Seattle that Amazon is cooking up a major artificial intelligence upgrade for its virtual assistant, Alexa. Internal plans reveal the high-stakes project is codenamed 'Moonraker.' The tech titan is desperate to inject new life into its household voice assistant to keep pace with rivals.

stories.headline: Meta Rolls Out Muse Image Generative AI Model
stories.summary: Social media giant Meta Platforms has officially unleashed its brand-new image-generation model, Muse Image. Developed by its Superintelligence Labs, the new tool is being injected directly into Meta's popular chat applications. The move marks another aggressive land grab in the consumer generative AI market.

stories.headline: Apple Commits Thirty Billion To Broadcom For Chips
stories.summary: Apple is doubling down on American manufacturing with a massive thirty-billion-dollar commitment to chipmaker Broadcom. The historic deal marks the iPhone maker's largest domestic manufacturing agreement to date. The cash injection will secure critical silicon supplies as the tech giant gears up for an AI-heavy future.

stories.headline: Former DeepMind Executive Warns AI Arms Race Nears Disaster
stories.summary: A former top boss at Google DeepMind is sounding the alarm on the global race for artificial intelligence. Verity Harding warned that the U.S. government's nationalistic stance is steering the world toward a worst-case scenario. She urges leaders to abandon the aggressive arms-race mentality before it is too late.

stories.headline: Short-Seller Warns AI Could Wipe Out Knowledge Jobs
stories.summary: A prominent Wall Street short-seller is predicting a devastating economic storm on the horizon. Carson Block warns that AI-driven automation could eliminate fifteen percent of all knowledge worker positions within three years. The rapid disruption could trigger a crisis rivaling the worst economic downturns in modern history.
